title: Foundry

text.text: The Foundry is an improved smeltery made of scorched bricks. It only accepts blazing blood as fuel and never alloys metals, keeping them separated.

Tier 4+ metals and alloys (queensslime, hepatizon, manyullyn, knightslime, fiery, nicrosil, blood) can only be melted and alloyed here. The melter is a 1x1 early-game furnace for low-temp metals (<=550C).

properties: Requires scorched bricks and blazing blood
No alloying (keeps metals separate) except Tier 4+ in foundry
